_comment: Domain profiles: what Reality Debugger can and cannot do in each domain with the models it actually ships. 'categories' must be labels of the server detector (checked at start-up). 'status': available | limited | experimental | unavailable. Evidence entries point to docs/benchmarks/records/.

general.name: General scenes
general.summary: Everyday scenes: the 80 COCO object categories, tracking in live video, scene relations and diagnostics.
unsupported: Objects outside the 80 COCO categories (measured: 56.6% of LVIS v1 instances and 81.1% of Open Images boxes have no COCO-80 equivalent)
Identifying people, reading text, measuring physical size without calibration

retail_inventory.name: Inventory and retail (A)
retail_inventory.summary: Counts and locates generic product-like COCO categories (bottles, cups, bowls, fruit, books...). It cannot recognise products, brands or SKUs, and it does not detect boxes, cartons, pallets or shelf gaps.
unsupported: Product / brand / SKU recognition (needs a product-specific detector trained on, e.g., SKU-110K or the store's own catalogue)
Boxes, cartons, pallets, price tags, barcodes, shelf gaps (no category in the shipped models)
Exact counts in dense shelves: overlapping identical items are merged or missed; counts are lower bounds
notes: Precision mode (tiled) is the default because shelf items are small in a wide photo.

industrial_inspection.name: Industrial inspection (B)
industrial_inspection.summary: Reference comparison: give 2-10 photos of known-good parts and one photo of a part to check, taken the same way. The server builds a PatchCore-style memory bank of the good parts and highlights regions that do not look like any of them.
unsupported: Defect classification (what kind of defect) and metrology (sizes in mm)
Parts photographed in a different pose, lighting or background than the references
Certified pass/fail decisions: this is a screening aid, every flag needs a human check
industrial_inspection.safety: Not a validated inspection system. Use for screening only; do not ship, reject or certify parts on its output alone.

robotics.name: Robotics and navigation (C)
robotics.summary: Detection and multi-object tracking with explicit track states (tentative, confirmed, occluded, lost, recovered) and camera-motion compensation; speeds are image-space unless the camera is calibrated.
unsupported: Metric depth, 3-D position or physical speed (no calibrated camera model; image-space motion only)
Safety-rated obstacle detection: no guarantee that an object is detected in every frame
robotics.safety: Not suitable for collision avoidance or any safety function.

medical_research.name: Medical and surgical research (D)
medical_research.summary: No medical or surgical model ships with this build: generic COCO detectors are not trained or validated on clinical images, so no medical analysis is offered.
unsupported: Surgical instrument detection or tracking (would need, e.g., a model trained on a surgical-tool dataset and an ethics-approved validation)
Any diagnosis, triage, measurement or guidance
medical_research.safety: Research prototype only. Not a medical device, not clinically validated, and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment or surgical guidance.
